caption: The drawing depicts a pair of black slip-on shoes placed near the center of a plain, light beige background. Each shoe features an embroidered floral pattern on the front, with flowers and leaves in red, green, yellow, and purple colors. The shoes have low, brown soles and a rounded toe shape. The interior lining of the shoes is illustrated in a light, off-white shade. The shoes are positioned slightly overlapping, with the left shoe in front of the right shoe. There is a small, unobtrusive artist’s signature in the bottom right corner. The composition is simple and centered, with ample empty space surrounding the shoes.
title: Baby Shoes
